verdict.rationale: No item in the evidence pack documents exporting or downloading a project's full source code, or running or hosting it outside Replit. The docs cover only Replit-hosted publishing, custom domains and built-in services. One community report mentions git operations inside Replit conflicting with the agent, which says nothing about off-platform export or hosting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform
